findings.claim: The v2 hook command `node "<launcher>" hook …` with a PATH-resolved absolute node path (E15) re-breaks the #613 fix if it goes into VS Code's `.github/hooks/context-mode.json`, which is a workspace-committed file.
findings.evidence: PRD-v2.md:166 E12 `node "<launcher>" hook …`; PRD-v2.md:169 E15 writes `/opt/homebrew/bin/node`; v1 src/adapters/vscode-copilot/hooks.ts:86-101 'Workspace (team-shared) ... Embedding process.execPath or any absolute pluginRoot path here: Leaks PII ... Breaks cross-machine portability'; ADR-0011:67 confirms the VS Code file is `<project>/.github/hooks/context-mode.json`.
findings.fix: State the VS Code install mode in the adapter table: either Agent Plugin (`/plugin install`, spike-distribution.md:20, no workspace file) or a workspace hook file with a portable command only. Add a GP11 golden: the VS Code hook config holds no absolute path and no username.
findings.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY: 6cb1490c 2026-05-18 'fix(family-A): persistence-tier rules — drop stale .mcp.json + portable Tier C hooks (#620)', closes #613; it reverted f5c9d02a 2026-03-06 'fix: use absolute node path in hook commands instead of CLI'. ORIGINAL_INTENT: commit body 'Why Tier C MUST be portable: ... .github/hooks/context-mode.json is workspace-committed and lands in every teammate's git status'. REGRESSION_RISK: high, the exact f5c9d02 shape comes back. SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: no machine-local path in any file under the user's repo; v2 has no npm global bin, so the old portable `context-mode` form is gone too, which forces a plugin install or a repo-relative launcher.

findings.claim: The VS Code compaction path keys the marker on `sid`, but VS Code hook payloads carry `session_id` only optionally. The docs give no VS Code session-id source and v1's fallback is not allowed (no fallback chains).
findings.evidence: ADR-0009:96 `meta('pending_compact:'+sid)`; ADR-0009:48 'An empty id means nothing is injected'; spike-hooks-verified.md:37 'session_id, transcript_path optional'; v1 src/adapters/vscode-copilot/index.ts:65-67 falls back to `vscode-${VSCODE_PID}` then `pid-${process.ppid}`.
findings.fix: Add a source check (vscode-copilot-chat hookExecutor) for when session_id is absent; if it can be absent, state in ADR-0009 that VS Code compaction recovery is a documented gap, not a fallback.
findings.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY: c302ce41 2026-04-25 'feat(stats): redesign ctx_stats output — token savings dashboard' (git blame -L 65,67). ORIGINAL_INTENT: no comment; the code shows a three-step fallback for missing sessionId. REGRESSION_RISK: silent no-op of compaction recovery on VS Code. SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: one source only, per owner decision.

findings.claim: v1 VS Code hooks live in every repo where the user ran setup, committed to git, and also in teammates' clones. One `ctx_upgrade` run cleans one project, so after `npm uninstall -g` every other repo keeps hooks that call a missing `context-mode` bin.
findings.evidence: ADR-0011:67 'Delete the file (project scope)'; ADR-0011:76 'After npm uninstall -g, these hooks fail until the cleanup runs'; v1 hooks.ts:88-90 'workspace-committed file ... lands in every teammate's git status'.
findings.fix: Release note and ADR-0015 §5: list the file path, say it is committed, and give the git command to remove it per repo; doctor reports it in the current project only. Decide whether deleting a tracked file is allowed or only reported.
findings.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY: 6cb1490c 2026-05-18 (#613/#620) made the file portable and team-shared. ORIGINAL_INTENT: 'lands in every teammate's git status'. REGRESSION_RISK: broken hooks in many repos; VS Code exit code other than 0/2 behavior unverified. SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: never edit user repos outside the scope run in (PRD E13).

findings.claim: VS Code is 'covered by Copilot CLI live run + hook-payload fixture E2E', but VS Code uses its own tool names and payload shape, and no doc says where recorded VS Code payloads come from. GP3 requires names from recorded native payloads.
findings.evidence: TECH-SPEC:368; TECH-SPEC:202 'never against hand-written strings (#1222)'; spike-hooks-verified.md:37 'Live: not possible (GUI)'; PRD-v2.md:241 separate vscode.ts and copilot-cli.ts.
findings.fix: Name the fixture source: payloads captured once by hand from a real VS Code session (version pinned), stored under tests, refreshed per VS Code release.
